identity.scope: equipped reference hero; not modular gear runtime replacement

rig.claim: Existing render chooses extract/climb/jump/fall/run/idle and passes aimAngle and recoil into generic joint rig; no selected whole-body source clips.

aim.claim: Aiming is held input; weapon charge and aimAngle are independent real state, no aim entry/exit timer.

canopyAttach.claim: Grip attaches to reachable support and may enter swing. Accepted support/climbing transition is the actual event.

canopyRelease.claim: Manual grip release, invalid support or exhausted stamina clears climb state; only manual release inherits explicit swing velocity branch here.

canopyJumpRelease.claim: Climb jump releases support and inherits swing velocity or rigid/flexible launch velocity; boosted jump is an accepted event.

canopyMotion.claim: Swing updates real physics; otherwise vertical climb and stamina update independently.

canopyFlexible.claim: Swing supports are vine, rope or chain.

canopySwing.claim: Swing grip point, angle, length and angular velocity own world motion. Art must not bake a fixed branch/rope or double world translation.

scan.claim: Accepted scan immediately costs 8 energy, sets .7 cooldown, .55 pulse; rejected input does not trigger accepted event.

manualCloak.claim: Manual cloak toggle: immediately disable if active; enable only energy>=20.

forcedDecloak.claim: forceDecloak clears boolean and queues cloak-off; not necessarily a voluntary wrist gesture.

cloakPresentation.claim: Cloak alpha applied by rendering; keep separate from authored gesture pixels.

energyCloak.claim: Energy exhaustion forces decloak; do not play voluntary off gesture on every false transition.

heal.claim: Accepted Medicomp consumes one, heals .46 maxHP immediately, cooldown 2, decloaks; no treatment simulation phase.

damage.claim: Accepted damage after guard conditions reduces HP, sets .55 invulnerability, decloaks; no existing stagger timer.

secondWind.claim: First lethal hit with Medicomp consumes one, sets secondWindUsed, restores .30 maxHP, energy floor .20 max, invulnerability 2 instantly.

death.claim: Death sets HP0, phase dead, paused true immediately. Animation cannot rely on advancing simulation elapsed.

modularContract.claim: Complete anatomy and separated customizable equipment required; fullbody draft studies cannot claim this contract by metadata.

actions.label: Attente respirante
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.trigger: grounded && !climbing && abs(velocityX)<=24, with higher priority actions absent
actions.notes: Hold baseline and body volume; no extra gameplay state.

actions.label: Entrée en visée du canon d’épaule
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.trigger: accepted false→true aiming transition, appropriate caster equipped
actions.notes: Native right-facing horizontal caster study; hands empty, blades retracted. Do not delay firing or cover bow/other weapons.

actions.label: Maintien de visée du canon d’épaule
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.trigger: aiming true with appropriate caster equipped
actions.notes: Independent body breathing; real aimAngle/cannon orientation and charge remain authoritative. This horizontal study does not cover all aim angles.

actions.label: Sortie de visée du canon d’épaule
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.notes: Presentation can be interrupted by movement, firing, aim reentry; no simulation exit lock.

actions.label: Accrochage à la prise
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.trigger: false→true player.climbing with reachable support, flexible-support study
actions.notes: Hands target world grip; no trunk/rope pixels baked into hero sheet.

actions.label: Maintien suspendu
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.trigger: climbing && valid support && !canopySwing && near-zero vertical velocity
actions.notes: Sustained grip study, not climbing up/down replacement. World support and grip alignment remain external.

actions.label: Lâcher de prise
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.trigger: deliberate grip-release or accepted climb-jump presentation event
actions.notes: Forced exhaustion/fall may need abrupt release and should not wait for voluntary reach gesture.

actions.label: Balancement suspendu
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.notes: Phase must derive from actual pendulum state, not independent free-run gameplay loop; review cycle does not move world actor.

actions.label: Impulsion aérienne
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.notes: aerialBoostUsed is persistent until reset; trigger accepted event, not boolean true every frame. No jetpack invented.

actions.label: Balayage au biomask
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.notes: Gesture is artistic supporting cue; existing pulse and resource effects occur immediately.

actions.label: Activation du camouflage
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.trigger: accepted manual cloak activation with energy>=20
actions.notes: No transparent fade burned into source hero; compositor controls effect. Do not wait for gesture to change cloaked.

actions.label: Désactivation volontaire du camouflage
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.notes: Do not bind this voluntary wrist-button gesture to every forceDecloak caused by damage/heal/exhaustion.

actions.label: Soin au Medicomp
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.trigger: playerHeal accepted after nonfull HP, charge, cooldown gates
actions.notes: Authored preparation/treatment/return is presentation only; recovery already immediate, no root/input lock.

actions.label: Reprise d’urgence — Second Wind
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.notes: Use accepted emergency event; HP and invulnerability immediate. Kneel/rise study must yield to locomotion; no new incapacitation time.

actions.label: Réaction à l’impact
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.trigger: accepted nonlethal hurtPlayer damage after guards
actions.notes: Do not turn .55 invulnerability into .55 hitstun or change control timing; short optional presentation cue.

actions.label: Chute et mort
actions.presentationClock: new presentation-only cursor or actual state phase; preview FPS is not simulation time
actions.trigger: transition to phase==='dead' without Second Wind
actions.notes: Death pauses simulation immediately. Future playback requires separate presentation clock; hold last prone pose, never loop or revive through clip.
